supersession_rule: ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-001 is preserved unedited at docs/ERN-SPORTS-EDITION-001-LOCK.json and docs/ERN-SPORTS-EDITION-001-LOCK.md as the historical lock of record. revision_reason: Registration of the three previously blocking references (REF-02, REF-03, REF-04). Reconciliation found five conflicts between the supplied approved plates and the text of ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-001. Per the packet reconciliation rule, no locked rule was edited in place.

registered_references.authority: continuity reference only; NOT authority for the necklace, quarterback orientation, field cast or defender posture
geometry authority for the FREE MARK lockup at pendant and tablet scale
registered_references.observed: filled black-and-gold mark. Circular lens at left; handle descending to the LOWER LEFT; brimmed hat outside the lens at upper right, overlapping the lens rim; legs descending beneath the hat; a small gold glyph inside the lens. No outer containing ring.
registered_references.quality_caveat: supplied at 145x127 px as a raster crop on a light ground, not vector and not transparent. Geometry is legible and sufficient to bind the lock; it is below the resolution requested for a master and is recorded as such. A vector master remains desirable and is NOT render-blocking.

Pendant artwork is the mark in the REF-02 free-mark geometry — lens lower left with handle descending to the lower left, brimmed hat outside the lens at upper right, legs beneath. Metal reads as polished SILVER / WHITE METAL, not gold or brass. Pendant seats on the upper sternum, slightly below the collarbone. Presenter wears a violet blazer, consistent with LOCK-01.

amendments.field: one mark, four scales, identical geometry
amendments.lock_001_text: The hat-and-magnifier mark appears at masthead scale, tablet scale, pendant scale and cup scale. Same geometry at every scale.
amendments.plate_evidence: REF-02 and REF-04 carry two geometrically different lockups. REF-02 free mark: no containing ring, hat outside the lens at upper right, handle lower left. REF-04 footer roundel: outer gold ring, hat INSIDE the lens area above the glass, handle descending to the LOWER RIGHT, gold line art on black.
amendments.resolution: LOCK-002 records a TWO-LOCKUP mark system, each lockup bound to the placements where the Chairman's own approved plate uses it. FREE MARK (REF-02 geometry): pendant, tablet rear. ROUNDEL LOCKUP (REF-04 geometry): footer left cell. Masthead and cup scale are NOT settled by either plate and carry forward from LOCK-001 pending a plate.
amendments.basis: placement evidence from the approved plates only; no geometry was invented, merged or redrawn

refinements.note: HISTORY LIVES IN NEW QUESTIONS. is set in gold caps over the right end of the centre promo panel artwork, not on paper ground in the right cell. The right cell is the category column alone.

The category column sits on paper ground as a separate narrow right column with a gold rule above and below. List order EDUCATION / TECHNOLOGY / CULTURE / COMMERCE / MEDIA / A HIGHER VIEW matches LOCK-001 exactly.
Pendant seats on the upper sternum, slightly below the collarbone, rather than at the collarbone. Scale reads as jewelry and is consistent with the two-finger-width rule.
QR block sits inside the black left cell at its right end, square and high contrast, framed by the cell rather than by a separate hairline rule.
